_about: Golden values for the maxent.jar v3.4.4 vs QMaxent v0.2.0 comparison reported in the accompanying manuscript (§ 3.3, Table 3, Fig. 4). Produced offline on the Pitta nympha dataset of Lee et al. (2025, GECCO 64:e03939), random_seed=42, with both programs given IDENTICAL presences and background (47 presences, 9,384 background points sampled by QMaxent v0.2.0 and exported in SWD format for maxent.jar). Replaces the v0.1.7 record.

implementation_equivalence._label: Experiment 1: full-data fits on identical inputs, no partition. Permutation importance evaluated on the training data in both programs (maxent.jar definition; QMaxent 'Training data' option).

lee_protocol._label: Experiment 2: Lee et al. (2025) final-model protocol (LQH, beta 4, ten random 75/25 presence splits, identical splits for both programs). Lee's KDE bias file is not reproduced.

partition_vs_beta._label: Experiment 3: QMaxent v0.2.0 CV AUC (mean, SD with ddof=1) on the full factorial beta x partition; maxent.jar random 10-fold for reference.

_tolerance_rationale: Training-AUC tolerance is 0.02 and prediction correlation must stay >= 0.85 because elapid's scikit-learn backend applies one regularization strength to all features while maxent.jar regularizes per feature class; on identical inputs the two fits agree closely but not to the third decimal. Rank-agreement minima encode the manuscript's qualitative claims (strong agreement at beta 4 and with Lee et al. 2025).

_provenance.scripts: Manuscript supplementary analysis (build_swd.py, exp1_equivalence.py, exp2_lee_protocol.py, exp3_partition_beta.py). Data not redistributed; see docs/golden-values.md.
